inputs.request_summary: [Draft: state the requester, proposed solution, and decision sought without treating the solution as selected.]
inputs.planning_boundary: [Draft: state the user task, user groups, current-process context, and proposed first-delivery boundary.]
inputs.supplied_material_status: [Draft: list supplied observations, reports, task examples, sources, and their known limits.]

problem_brief.user_groups_and_current_work: [Draft: identify each group, trigger, task, current process, and specific difficulty with its evidence status.]
problem_brief.task_classes: [Draft: include a representative input, needed result, and material variation for every in-scope task class.]
problem_brief.relationships: [Draft: identify upstream dependencies and failure/change effects, plus downstream consumers and their next decisions.]
problem_brief.scope_boundary: [Draft: list exclusions, unverified assumptions, and questions that could change the brief.]

success_record.outcome_and_case_rules: [Draft: define the user outcome, functional behavior, prohibited behavior, and case-dependent clarification, decline, escalation, partial-result, or failure paths.]
success_record.dimensions_and_metrics: [Draft: identify only material value, task, safety, reliability, latency, or economics dimensions and define population, unit, method, status rules, and baseline status.]
success_record.predeclared_targets: [Draft: name target, critical slices, accountable owner, and consequence before any candidate result; use unselected where unavailable.]
success_record.evidence_handoff: [Draft: state the claims, cases, boundary observations, and identities that later evidence work must cover.]

suitability_record.comparison_boundary: [Draft: use the same task, cases, user contexts, sources, constraints, and prohibited effects for every alternative.]
suitability_record.alternatives_and_baseline: [Draft: name the actually considered alternatives and the simplest plausible baseline, with task-specific retained/rejected/unproven rationale.]
suitability_record.fit_assessment: [Draft: assess task uncertainty, usable data, action space, error consequence, maintenance burden, and evaluation burden.]
suitability_record.classification_and_added_value: [Draft: distinguish predefined transitions from model-directed next-action, sequencing, or stopping; state the adaptive added-value claim or why an agent is unselected.]
suitability_record.revisit_conditions: [Draft: name changes or comparable evidence that would reopen this choice.]

initial_scope_record.uses_and_affected_parties: [Draft: record intended and prohibited uses, affected users/non-users/systems, plausible scenarios, and unresolved specialist applicability.]
initial_scope_record.sources_connections_and_capabilities: [Draft: for each proposed source/connection state purpose, owner, access, sensitivity, freshness, handling; for each capability state authority, external effect, reversibility, and execution-class question.]
initial_scope_record.responsibility_map: [Draft: name reachable business, technical, operating, source/access, containment, restart, and review authorities or mark each unassigned.]
initial_scope_record.bounded_delivery: [Draft: state eligible users, task/data/capability limits, entry and expansion evidence, support, stop conditions, containment, notification, and restart questions.]

next_leaves: [Draft: name each explicitly required later leaf after checking library availability.]
planning_handoff.unresolved_decisions: [Draft: list the conditions that prevent contract, trust-boundary, evidence, readiness, or operations work from proceeding.]
planning_handoff.authorization_statement: [Draft: this planning packet grants no authority, approval, access, deployment, or risk acceptance.]

assumptions: [Draft assumption draft-assumption-current-work: the described current task and difficulty are representative of the intended user group; validate with a representative walkthrough or process record. Owner: unassigned.]
blockers: [Draft blocker draft-blocker-ownership: no reachable business, technical, and operating owners have been confirmed; do not progress to user exposure or represent ownership as settled. Resolution owner: unassigned.]
